newsitem.title: UK: BBC extends Arabic Service hours.
newsitem.headline: BBC extends Arabic Service hours.

text.p: The British Broadcasting Corporation said on Monday that it would extend broadcasts on its Arabic Service by five hours a day from next month.
"Continuing crises in the region make it imperative that the BBC is there on air when news breaks," Gamon McLellan, head of the Arabic Service, said in a statement.
The service, which broadcasts to audiences across Northern Africa and the Middle East, will be extended by five hours to close a gap between the breakfast show and the lunchtime programmes.
From May 5, it will be on air for 17 hours and 45 minutes a day from 0330 to 2115 GMT.
